group.name: plugin_doctor
group.title: Plugin Doctor Settings
group.description: Control how Plugin Doctor scans plugins, detects conflicts and keeps restoration points.

settings.name: plugin_doctor_cache_minutes
settings.title: Cache Scan Results (Minutes)
settings.description: How long a completed health scan is reused before it is treated as stale. Set to 0 to always treat the cached scan as stale and prompt for a fresh one. Scans never start automatically; the page always asks first.

settings.name: plugin_doctor_ignored_paths
settings.title: Ignored Paths
settings.description: One path or folder name per line. Ignored paths are skipped by the file, dependency and symbol scanner. Useful for temp, vendor, backup and log folders.
settings.value:
inc/plugins/temp
vendor
node_modules
.git
backups
logs
cache

settings.name: plugin_doctor_check_syntax
settings.title: Check PHP Syntax
settings.description: Parse plugin PHP files and report syntax errors before they can break the forum. Requires PHP 7 or newer for full parse-error reporting.

settings.name: plugin_doctor_scan_dependencies
settings.title: Scan Dependencies
settings.description: Find require and include references to other plugin files. Missing dependencies are reported before they cause a fatal error.

settings.name: plugin_doctor_scan_hook_overlaps
settings.title: Scan Hook Overlaps
settings.description: List hooks used by more than one active plugin and detect duplicate hook callbacks at the same priority. Hook overlaps are informational unless a callback is duplicated.

settings.name: plugin_doctor_show_inactive
settings.title: Show Inactive Plugins
settings.description: Include inactive plugin files in the inventory and conflict scan. Turn this off to focus only on plugins that are currently loaded.

settings.name: plugin_doctor_safe_mode_keep
settings.title: Safe Mode Exceptions
settings.description: One plugin codename per line. These active plugins stay enabled when safe mode is switched on. Plugin Doctor always stays enabled while it is running.

settings.name: plugin_doctor_max_plugins
settings.title: Maximum Plugins Per Scan
settings.description: Stop after this many plugin entry files. Set to 0 to scan every plugin file on the board. This is the default for automatic scans and can be overridden in the manual scan form.

settings.name: plugin_doctor_max_files_per_plugin
settings.title: Maximum Files Per Plugin
settings.description: Stop scanning one plugin after this many files. Set to 0 for no limit. A low limit protects large plugin folders from long scans.

settings.name: plugin_doctor_max_file_size_kb
settings.title: Maximum File Size (KB)
settings.description: Skip content parsing for a single PHP file larger than this size. File size and count are still reported. Set to 0 to parse every file.
